welcome.subject: Welcome to BMO Robot!
welcome.body:
Hi {name},

Welcome to BMO Robot! We are excited to help you build eco-friendly habits through on-device AI, federated learning, and a touch of friendly competition.

To get started, log in and complete your first scan.

— The BMO Robot team

password_reset.body:
Hi {name},

We received a request to reset your BMO Robot password. If you made this request, use the link below within 24 hours to set a new password.

Reset link: {link}

If you did not request this, you can safely ignore this email — your password will remain unchanged.

— The BMO Robot team
